_comment: OPTIMAL random-init control for HepG2 - which is the ORIGINAL recipe, unchanged. Retuning did NOT beat it: a 9-config grid's validation winner (lr3e-3/bs256/do0.2, val 0.6639 vs baseline 0.6538) scored only 0.6576 on test, BELOW this config's 0.6613. The validation gain was ~2 SE and did not transfer. This file exists so all three cells share the *_random_init_optimal.json convention; its contents are identical to mpra_HepG2_random_init.json.
_source: Random-init retuning campaign concluded no change was warranted; see docs/randinit_control.md
_selection: Grid selected on full-dataset validation Pearson; its winner then lost to this config on test, so the original recipe is retained as the best known.
